rationale.intuition:
Asymmetric regression check — complementary to fixture 108 (Adelphi ED). Adelphi DOES offer non-binding Early Action; the hasEarlyAction=false guard in roundMultiplier must NOT incorrectly fire here. If the PR #292/#293 PROGRAM_NOT_OFFERED data fix over-corrected by marking Adelphi hasEarlyAction=false, this fixture catches the over-fire: an EA applicant would get no boost (delta ~0) when in fact EA should provide a modest 5-25pp lift via either (a) school-published eaAcceptanceRate if scrapped, or (b) the heuristic ×1.30 EA fallback (which hits the anchor×2.5 upper clamp at high-acceptance schools like Adelphi 66%).

Boundary semantics:
- expectedMinDelta=-0.02 — EA must not be SIGNIFICANTLY lower than RD (no perverse anti-EA penalty).
- expectedMaxDelta=+0.25 — EA at a 66%-accept school × heuristic 1.3 caps via the anchor×2.5 clamp (98%) vs RD 77.6%, producing up to ~+20pp legitimate delta. Slack of 5pp absorbs minor float drift.

Pair with fixture 108: 108 asserts ED collapses to RD (no fabricated ED boost); 112 asserts EA preserves its legitimate boost. Together they verify the data-layer fix didn't over-correct.
